title: Learning fair representation with a parametric integral probability metric

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Adult dataset by measuring Demographic Parity (DP), Mean DP, Strong DP, and Variance of DP on a downstream income classification task, using gender as the sensitive attribute.
Evaluated using the COMPAS dataset by measuring Demographic Parity (DP) and its variants on a downstream recidivism prediction task, using race as the sensitive attribute.

Evaluated using the Health dataset by measuring Demographic Parity (DP) and its variants on downstream health risk and insurance claim predictions, using binarized age (threshold of 70) as the sensitive attribute.
